description: One run of the whiteboard application as PLC I/O, used by the in-browser demo (src/sim/demo.ts) and the MQTT simulator (scripts/simulate.mjs). Follows NewProgram in plc/ProjetoFinalRobotica. Channels: DIn = X20DI9371 channel n, DOn = X20DO9322 channel n. DI12 (E-stop, TRUE = safe) is always on. Times in seconds.

events.note: Start: enables and Jaka DI3 (put the plate on the conveyor)
Sensor Jaka: plate on the conveyor
Jaka DO7 done; PLC clears DI3 and starts the conveyor
Sensor Staubli: plate arrived; PLC stops the conveyor and sets Staubli DI12
Staubli DO4 done (both parts on the board); PLC clears DI12
Staubli clears DO4; PLC sets DI14 (pick the marker and draw)
Staubli DO5 done (marker stored); PLC clears DI14
Staubli clears DO5; cycle counted, PLC clears Ligar and the enables
